description: A credit operations director must authorize a progress draw from a commercial construction loan and finalize the draw amount, lien protection, and disbursement control, with input from legal collateral review and construction finance.

shared_context.S1: The borrower is requesting a $3,000,000 progress draw from its approved commercial construction facility.
shared_context.S2: The facility has sufficient undrawn capacity, and all previously released draws are current.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding decision on whether and how to release this draw.
shared_context.S4: Under the team's normal pre-release process, Maya conducts a final check-in with collateral counsel and construction finance before authorizing any draw.

PF1.text: Elias received a title-search update this morning showing an unresolved mechanic's lien claim; the collateral policy therefore requires a $300,000 lien holdback and payment of the approved draw into the project's controlled disbursement account, but he has not yet attached the update to the credit file.

PF2.text: Nora received the independent inspector's report today confirming that completed work supports exactly a $2,400,000 eligible progress draw rather than the requested $3,000,000; the report has not yet been uploaded to the loan system.

acceptance_conditions: The progress draw must be approved.
The draw amount must be exactly $2,400,000.
Exactly $300,000 must be withheld as a lien holdback.
The approved draw must be paid into the project's controlled disbursement account.
The settlement must include an executable controlled-disbursement commitment.
The unresolved mechanic's lien must be cited as justification for the holdback and controlled disbursement.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: Without PF1, the clean current facility supports releasing the requested draw without a holdback or controlled account; PF1 changes lien_holdback_usd to exactly 300000 and controlled_disbursement_account_required to true.

Without PF2, a generic release would either approve the requested 3000000 or decline for lack of verified progress; PF2 changes the approvable draw_amount_usd to exactly 2400000 and supports draw_approved as true.
